Hybrid Model Performance (Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation)

Each target uses whichever approach scored highest under LOOCV on the 28 real stations: a Baseline model (lat/lon/elevation only), an ERA5 naive feature model (ERA5 value added as a direct input), or an ERA5 residual-correction model (predicts only the station–ERA5 difference, then adds it back to ERA5 at the target location). "R² (Baseline)" is shown alongside for direct comparison. See the accompanying validation report for full methodology and independent (out-of-sample) validation results.

✕

Enter Coordinates Manually

Enter latitude/longitude for any location in Libya. Elevation is optional — if left blank it will be estimated automatically.
